review.notes: Full review. Previous R02-R06 repaired; R01 repaired in substance but the new scope sentence attributes the stable stems to GeometryOfNumbersAndQuadraticArithmetic 6.1a, which disclaims them (R01). Seeded sample of 15 targets verified against kbook, kahn, borel1974/1977, wildkernel, hutchinson, fgv, sharifi, ribet, caputo and groenewegen; Bass-Tate waived. Worker gate passes; plain gate rerun reports depcheck UPWARD to GeometryOfNumbersAndQuadraticArithmetic against the repository order, and the moved-order depcheck reports 0 problems (238 roadmaps, 2349 edges). Suggested.lean elaborates with three sorry warnings; #check matches signatures; one-tactic probes close nothing. All nine findings are P3: a false ownership attribution, content dropped while K3BlochGroups still cites it, a gap contract wider than plan.json, unsourced hypotheses for bottEtaleDescent, an uncited pinned S-unit rank theorem (TauCeti.finrank_sUnits), two locator defects, a nonexistent declaration name, and a docstring overstating what the pins lack. Eight source issues recorded.
